name: huginn
description: Brand kit and design system for Huginn — a studio for slow software.

scripts.build: npm run build:tokens && npm run build:brand && npm run build:inline && npm run build:component
scripts.audit: npm run audit:contrast && npm run audit:motion
scripts.audit:contrast: node scripts/audit-contrast.mjs --theme light && node scripts/audit-contrast.mjs --theme dark
scripts.shots: node scripts/shot.mjs --url design-system.html --out docs/shots/1440-full.png --w 1440 --h 1000 --full && node scripts/shot.mjs --url design-system.html --out docs/shots/390-full.png --w 390 --h 844 --full && node scripts/shot.mjs --url design-system.html --out docs/shots/1440-dark-full.png --w 1440 --h 1000 --full --theme dark
